title: GitHub's new dashboard experience now the default
summary: GitHub has rolled out a redesigned dashboard experience as the new default for all users, featuring improved navigation, better activity feeds, and a more modern user interface for managing repositories, projects, and notifications.
problem_solved: Provides users with a more intuitive and streamlined interface for managing their developer workflow and staying organized on GitHub.
why_valuable: Enhances developer productivity and user experience by offering a cleaner, more responsive dashboard that reduces friction in daily GitHub activities.
